subject: c10-sci

weightage.label: Natural Phenomena: Light and Eye (Ch 10 to 12)

note: Marks are official and given per unit (theory total 80, internal assessment 20). Periodic Classification (Ch 2) and Heredity and Evolution (Ch 9) are marked as not in the year-end exam. Question mix: knowledge and understanding 50%, application 30%, formulate, analyse, evaluate and create 20%. About 33% internal choice is given.
mistakes: Chemical equations: balance them, and add state symbols or conditions when the question asks.
Ray diagrams: draw rays with arrows, label the points, and apply the sign convention in numericals.
Electricity numericals: write the formula, substitute with units, and check whether the resistors are in series or parallel.
Biology diagrams: draw neat, labelled diagrams and label every part the question asks for.
Assertion-reasoning questions: read both statements carefully and test each one separately.
Case-based questions: read the whole passage before you answer.
order: Chemical Substances (25 marks) and World of Living (25 marks) first: together they are 50 of 80 marks.
Then Effects of Current (13 marks): Electricity and Magnetic Effects.
Then Light and the Human Eye (12 marks).
Our Environment (5 marks) is a short unit to revise before the exam.
Read Chapters 2 and 9 for school tests, but they are not in the year-end exam.
